categories.title: Ancestral Tree
categories.info: Grant new **Skills**

categories.title: Element of Light
categories.info: Elements are major story-related parts that grant the ability to reach new areas all over **Nibel** that could not have been accessible before

categories.title: Energy Gate
categories.info: Energy Gates require a specific amount of **Energy Cells** to open

categories.title: Major Spirit Gate
categories.info: Spirit Gates require a specific amount of **Keystones** to open

categories.title: Map Stone
categories.info: Restored with **Map Stone Fragments** to reveal map areas and collectible icons

categories.title: Minor Spirit Gate
categories.info: Spirit Gates require a specific amount of **Keystones** to open

categories.title: Spirit Well
categories.info: Save Point, restores Health and Energy. Also functions as a Fast Travel point in the **Definitive Edition** of the game

categories.title: Ability Point
categories.info: **Ability Points** are used in the **Ability Tree** menu to upgrade Ori's skills

categories.title: Energy Cell
categories.info: Increases maximum **Energy**

categories.title: Keystone
categories.info: **Keystones** are used to open **Spirit Gates**

categories.title: Life Cell
categories.info: Fully heals and increases maximum **Health**

categories.title: Map Stone Fragment
categories.info: **Map Fragments** are used to complete **Map Stones** to reveal specific area

categories.title: Spirit Light Container
categories.info: By collecting the required amount of **Spirit Light**, grants **Ability Points**

categories.title: Breakable Wall
categories.info:
Most Breakable Walls require the **[Charge Flame](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561431)** Skill to break.
Alternatively, **[Bash](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561383)** enemy projectiles into them or throw [Light Burst](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561473)

categories.title: Energy Shard
categories.info: Restores power to Energy Cells

categories.title: Lantern
categories.info: Lanterns can be lit with [Light Burst](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561473) Skill

categories.title: Lever
categories.info: Levers can move platforms, open gates, drain water, and trigger other environmental changes

categories.title: Life Shard
categories.info: Restores vitality to Life Cells

categories.title: Locked Gate
categories.info: Locked Gates can be opened by interacting with **Levers** and **Stompable Pillars**

categories.title: Secret Passage
categories.info: A Hidden Path that leads to various Collectibles and Landmarks

categories.title: Spirit Light Bulb
categories.info: Require the **[Charge Flame](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561431)** Skill to open

categories.title: Stompable Floor
categories.info: Stompable Floors require the **[Stomp](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561582)** and sometimes [Charge Jump](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561222) Skills to break through or use nearby enemies

categories.title: Stompable Pillar
categories.info: Using the [Stomp](https://mapgenie.io/ori-and-the-blind-forest/maps/nibel?locationIds=561582) Skill on top of the Pillar opens certain doors
